comment: Best butter chicken in town! Creamy and perfectly spiced.

The Margherita pizza rivals any Italian restaurant.
Healthy and delicious! Love the protein bowls.
These burgers are absolutely massive and tasty!
The Hyderabadi biryani is out of this world. So fragrant!
Best biryani I've had outside Hyderabad.
The chocolate lava cake is divine.
Pasta was al dente, just the way I like it.
Good Chinese food. The dragon chicken is spicy and flavorful.
Reminds me of Mumbai streets. Amazing pav bhaji!
Fresh and authentic. The rava dosa is a must try!
Great pizza but a bit pricey for the portion.
The macarons are absolutely beautiful and delicious.
